name: AutoFPCount
description: Frame-window analyser and macro recorder/playback overlay for Geometry Dash. Decodes Silicate, XDBot, Mega Hack and Eclipse macro files, enforces a strict 240 TPS ingestion gate, and draws per-click frame-window circles with their equivalent frame-rate ceiling plus a live 'Frame Window: Count' statistics list.

enable-overlay.name: Enable Overlay
enable-overlay.description: Draw the per-click window circles, frame-rate labels and the corner statistics list.

enable-recorder.name: Enable Recorder
enable-recorder.description: Capture raw click/release input while the attempt is running so it can be exported as a 240 FPS macro.

reject-non-240.name: Strict 240 FPS Gate
reject-non-240.description: Refuse to ingest any macro file whose declared tick rate is not exactly 240 FPS.

force-60-override.name: 60 FPS Window Override
force-60-override.description: Relabel a 5-8 frame window as '60 FPS' when the press landed on the 60 Hz tick grid (tick % 4 == 0), the nearest interaction boundary was a ground or slope transition, time warp is exactly 1.0, and playback is at normal speed. A display heuristic only: the bucket in the statistics list is not changed.

enable-accelerated.name: Accelerated Timescale
enable-accelerated.description: EXPERIMENTAL. Drives extra logic ticks per rendered frame during playback. Bounded by a hard step cap; refuses to run rather than silently dropping steps.

show-boundary-dots.name: Show Interaction Boundaries
show-boundary-dots.description: Draw a small dot on each rendered frame at the player's position when the collision/interaction state changed on that frame's last tick. These are the ticks the window search measures against.

auto-start-playback.name: Auto Start Playback
auto-start-playback.description: Begin replaying the ingested macro automatically at the start of each attempt. Disable this if you only want the window analysis on live input.
